name: GermplasmPro
description: A browser-based platform for the day-to-day management of plant genetic resources collections, for any species and any conservation route (seed bank, field genebank, in vitro, cryopreservation, in situ and on-farm): MCPD v2.1 passport data with extension fields, automatic column recognition and validation, coordinate checks and duplicate detection, offline collecting maps, geographic diversity with rarefaction and richness estimators, collecting gaps with a priority index and complementarity, characterization with Gower distance, PCoA, clustering and validated core collections, Ellis-Roberts viability projection, work alerts and workload, millimetre-accurate labels with QR and Code 128 codes, and a self-contained report with MCPD and Darwin Core export. No installation, no third-party libraries, Spanish and English.
softwareRequirements: A modern web browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari)
